🎥🚔: Super Troopers 3 (2026)

The boys are back in uniform, and this time the biggest emergency might be Farva’s wedding. With Farva preparing to marry Thorny’s sister, the Vermont troopers are pulled into a celebration filled with questionable decisions, ridiculous plans, and enough chaos to make everyone regret getting involved.

But wedding drama isn’t their only problem. A new drug ring puts the crew back on the job, forcing them to balance an actual investigation with their usual collection of pranks, rivalries, and completely unnecessary trouble.

Super Troopers 3 brings the gang together for another wild ride packed with absurd comedy, unpredictable antics, and the dysfunctional friendship fans have come to love.

In theatres August 7. Get tickets now at Searchlight Pictures.

source_details.synopsis: Super Troopers 3 (billed as Super Troopers 3: Farva’s Wedding, onscreen only) is a 2026 American comedy film directed by Jay Chandrasekhar. A sequel to the 2018 film Super Troopers 2, the film was written by and stars the Broken Lizard comedy team, made up of Chandrasekhar, Kevin Heffernan, Steve Lemme, Paul Soter and Erik Stolhanske. Super Troopers 3 was released in the United States by Searchlight Pictures on August 7, 2026, it received mixed reviews from critics.
